assignment: 184-6 n17 final offline VISUAL review only

headlessEvidenceBasis: Existing n17-offline/results.json; no new browser execution.
observationMethod: Each entire faithful native-pixel sheet was opened exactly once with functions.view_image; all columns were inspected in source order.

pixelPreservation.order: Each column top-to-bottom, then columns left-to-right.
pixelPreservation.rectanglesAndRawPixelHashes: See transform-receipt.json for every source and sheet rectangle, raw RGB hash, source PNG SHA256, and sheet PNG SHA256.
